definition: a small workplace where things are made
description: Inside a small craft workshop. Two hands hold a black open-ended spanner next to a shiny chrome one, comparing them against a pale board where a whole graded row of spanners hangs in size order. A woman in navy overalls and safety glasses then stands at a workbench with a clamp and vice, using two fine tools to fit a small brass clock movement with visible toothed wheels. At the end she reaches up to a carved wooden cuckoo clock hanging on the timber wall while a colleague works behind her.
